item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: evoLL
  • 発売日: 2022-03-25
  • スコア: 7.01/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 南国プリズン ～漂流した無人島が子作りしないと出られない島だった件～
  • 英語名: Nangoku Prison Hyouryuu Shita Mujintou ga Kozukuri Shinai to Derarenai Shima Datta Ken

あらすじ

Reijirou finds himself stranded on a deserted island with three beauties: Teen idol Nasu Arina, her manager Natsuki and his student Yume. Arina sees a golden opportunity to lose her virginity to her beloved ‘sensei’ but Natsuki will do anything to protect her. Throwing herself at Reijirou in hopes he’ll use her body instead but her plan fails. Arina is desperate to throw off the shackles of chastity and she will not be stopped.

item.description:

  • ブランド: evoLL
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Ｈではじめるストラテジー！ ～キュートレア経営復興計画～
  • 英語名: H de Hajimeru Strategy! Cute Rare Keiei Fukkou Keikaku

あらすじ

Nowadays, topicality and fashion are required even for lunch and tea time.

This is the family restaurant “Cutrea”, which is being overwhelmed by the trends of the times. However, the store manager (Mariya), the eldest daughter of the three sisters, managed to make the store prosperous.

Every day, the second daughter (Inori) and the third daughter (Kanae) are involved, and the main character tries out some kind of service that has gone too far.

item.title: H de Hajimaru Share House
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: evoLL
  • 発売日: 2018-08-31
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (87 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Hではじまるシェアハウス
  • 英語名: H de Hajimaru Share House

あらすじ

After living 10 years away from his hometown in a foreign country, Kanata returned to settle there to continue his studies. He was surprised to see his older sister and his other childhood friends again to see that they had all grown up and changed a lot.

Upon his arrival, Kanata realizes that he will not only live with his sister Touka in a house, but with many attractive young women including Touka, Aya and Kazane in addition to the cute landlord named Rina and the mature and attractive Sakura-sensei.
